digest.component_or_area: rebar search CLI and library interface
propositions: Default rebar search returns full ticket bodies and comments, exhausting agent context with oversized discovery output (203 KB baseline)
Search lacks --output flag recognition; rebar search --output json exits with status 2 instead of formatting results
No durable summary field exists in the event/state schema; search must derive discovery summaries from descriptions truncated to 240 characters
Snippet extraction for matched terms requires case-preserving context window (240 char max) centered on the first matching positive term, sourced from any field without returning full bodies
Predicate-only and negation-only queries must return null snippet instead of description-derived context
Search, show, and MCP need separate canonical schemas (SearchResult, TicketState) with library and CLI type overloads to distinguish full versus summary-only results
